newsitem.title: USA: TVA Sequoyah 2 Tenn. nuclear unit hits full power.
newsitem.headline: TVA Sequoyah 2 Tenn. nuclear unit hits full power.

text.p: TVA Nuclear's 1,148 nuclear power unit 2 was operating at full power as of early Wednesday, returning from a scheduled shutdown, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said.
The unit, located in Soddy-Daisy, Tenn., was shut Oct 11 for refueling and maintenance.
It was operating at 100 percent of capacity as of early Wednesday, the NRC said in its daily plant status report.
The adjacent 1,148 megawatt Sequoyah unit 1 continued to operate at full capacity, the NRC said.
TVA Nuclear is a unit of the Tennessee Valley Authority.
